units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 37b:7">Bekh. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>הס׳ כל שהוא</he> a slit in the ear disqualifies, even if it be of the minutest size.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:8">Koh. R. to I, 8</cite> <he>כמבין סִידְקוֹ של פתח</he> like looking through the crack of a door; a. e.—Pl. <he>סְדָקִים</he>, <he>סְדָקִון</he>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 8a:5">Pes. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>לחורין ולס׳</he> into holes and fissures.

Ib. III, 5 (48ᵇ) סִודּוּק שנתערבו סְדָקָיו וכ׳ (Bab. ed. סדקין) dough is called sidduḳ, when its cracks run into one another. Ib. 48ᵇ אין לך כל סדק וסדק … כמה ס׳ וכ׳ for every crack on the surface there are several inside. Ib. III, 2 סִדְקֵי עריבה (Bab. ed. 45ᵃ סִידְקֵי) the cracks in the kneading trough; a. fr.
